evidence.reason: The projection indexes `ITEM_KINDS` with an unvalidated `kind`. A JSON list (or other unhashable JSON value) at `item["kind"]` makes the membership test raise `TypeError`, so the intended unknown-kind fallback is skipped. The adjacent state handling already requires `isinstance(state, str)` before set membership; the same guard is needed here. The cited history only fixed the state check, not this kind check.
